tools.name: launch_nro
tools.description: Start a homebrew .nro from the SD card without navigating the Homebrew Menu. Needs hbmenu open with its netloader running: open the Homebrew Menu and press Y once (the screen says it is waiting for nxlink); the call fails with that instruction otherwise. hbmenu then exits and starts the NRO, exactly like nxlink from a PC. The NRO must be under /switch/. Upload a new build first (PUT /files or upload_file), then call this.

path.description: The NRO on the SD card, under /switch/, e.g. /switch/myapp/myapp.nro.

args.description: Command-line arguments after argv[0]. At most 1 KB in all.
